card.name: Words leading into 'important' or 'vital'
card.fires_on: Small words just before an expected 'important', 'vital', or 'critical' in a sentence stressing urgency or significance, such as 'it's more', 'it is especially', 'a healthy diet is'. It also fires on a few other words in the middle of a phrase, such as the start of a web address.

modes.label: Before 'important'
modes.description: A linking or intensifying word right before 'important' or 'vital' in advice or public-health text.
modes.example: In those cases, it’s<< more>> important than ever to put sunscreen on correctly

modes.label: Urgency phrases
modes.description: A word inside a phrase of timeliness or need, just before a word like 'critical' or 'time'.
modes.example: could not<< come>> at a more critical time.

modes.label: Other mid-phrase words
modes.description: Scattered words in web addresses or names with no link to importance.
